text: {"lessons":["Selling winners has felt satisfying, but I should not sell solely to lock in a gain; consider each stock’s prospects and my overall plan.","My reluctance to admit a mistake can keep me holding a losing position too long, so I should reassess it objectively rather than anchor on its average cost.","A few months of gains followed by a small decline is not enough to judge my approach; with infrequent trading, I should stay patient and avoid reacting to short-term moves."]}
